issues.summary: Daehan Precision's production line would stop on 2026-05-07 unless the industrial sensors in container HMLU6425478 (HBL MFCIM260019 / MBL HMLU260703) were cleared and delivered the same day, 2026-05-06.

decisions.summary: Jiwoo Han accepted Harbor Gate's USD 150 expedite fee to clear HBL MFCIM260019 the same day, with the fee to be invoiced to Meridian Freight.

tasks.summary: Minseo Park to approve Thomas Kwon's request that Meridian absorb the USD 150 Harbor Gate expedite fee as goodwill instead of billing Daehan Precision.
